scope: Stat variants of enemies the pool already carries. Each one is a copy of an authored record with a few authored numbers changed; models, animations and sounds are the base enemy's, so nothing new has to be loaded.
notation: 'x1.5' multiplies the authored float, '=12' sets a float, 'i1' sets a raw dword (for the 0/1 switches). A key is 'Component.CMD_Name'; every field of that name in the record is changed, so the limb damages all move together. 'speed' is the animation playback factor applied at runtime (1.25 = a quarter faster, movement included); 'scale' is the visual size factor, collision stays, so keep it modest. 'skin' copies the base model with recoloured textures and gives the variant its own look: 'package' is the character stream under ds_assets/char_str/npc, 'tag' the character that replaces the last one of every renamed texture name, 'tint' recolours every diffuse (_c) texture, either [r,g,b] multipliers or {"hue": degrees, "sat": factor, "val": factor} in HSV; 'tints' does the same per texture stem (also for glow maps, _l), 'files' takes a DDS (same format and size, saved with mipmaps) instead of a tint. Every texture the copied materials name travels along; a material must find all of them when the pool loads. 'vfx' recolours effects the model names, per effect stem: {"light": [r, g, b]} sets its light colour (0..1). 'sounds' swaps the animation bank's sound events by name (old event -> event of another enemy whose package is forced resident), the DS1 way.
